definitions.explanation: A beetle with very long antennae and strong jaws. Its larvae bore into wood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カミキリムシがいた。
examples.english: There was a longhorn beetle on the tree.

examples.japanese: カミキリムシ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{触角|しょっかく}→触角：31305_shokkaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

カミキリムシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{果樹園|かじゅえん}→果樹園：06472_kajuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Longhorn beetle larvae eat their way through wood, so orchards treat them as pests.

notes:
Written {髪切虫|かみきりむし} in kanji ('hair-cutting insect', from its strong jaws), but usually in katakana. A familiar summer insect for children, along with ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧ and ⟦クワガタ→クワガタ：05130_kuwagata⟧.
